description: This file defines a grain class for Orleans, implementing state management for a list of names, including methods to retrieve and add names, along with a serializable state class.

classes.name: Initialized_State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of the grain, containing a list of names.

classes.name: InitialStateGrain
classes.description: Grain implementation managing the initialized state with methods to get and add names.

methods.name: GetNames
methods.description: Returns the list of names stored in the grain's state.

methods.name: AddName
methods.description: Adds a new name to the state and persists it.
